context: Two managers prep a leadership handover briefing
purpose: Teach: 出展/移譲/監修/補欠/採点/燃焼/立証/責務

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 健司さん、来週の引き継ぎ説明会の資料、少しお時間いただけますか？
lines.en: Kenji, do you have a little time to go over the handover briefing materials for next week?
lines.style: Polite professional tone with a collaborative opening request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろん。まず、今回の人事で部長の責務がかなり大きく変わるから、そこを丁寧に説明しないとね。
lines.en: Of course. First, the director's responsibilities are changing significantly with this reshuffle, so we need to explain that carefully.
lines.style: Calm senior colleague, measured and businesslike with steady delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ。特に予算決裁の権限移譲については、誤解されると後々もめそうなので。
lines.en: Yes. Especially the delegation of budget approval authority — if it's misunderstood, it could cause trouble later.
lines.style: Slightly worried, articulate, anticipating future complications professionally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そこは森本顧問の監修で社内規程の改定案を作ってもらったから、根拠を示せば立証は難しくないはずだよ。
lines.en: We had the internal rule revision drafted under advisor Morimoto's supervision, so if questions arise we can substantiate the change without difficulty.
lines.style: Reassuring factual senior, citing authority without arrogance or pressure.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。あと、後任候補の件ですが、補欠に挙がっていた佐藤さんの採点はどうなりましたか？
lines.en: That helps. Also, about the successor candidates — how did Sato-san, who was on the backup list, score?
lines.style: Polite inquiry shifting topic smoothly with mildly hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: プレゼンでしっかり力を出し切ってくれて、得点はトップだったよ。展示会への出展経験もあるし、即戦力だと思う。
lines.en: He really gave his all in the presentation and ended up scoring the highest. He also has trade show exhibition experience, so he's ready to contribute immediately.
lines.style: Calm businesslike endorsement, measured praise from a senior colleague.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど、それなら安心ですね。佐藤さんなら新規プロジェクトでも完全燃焼してくれそうです。
lines.en: I see, that's reassuring. With Sato-san, I imagine he'll throw himself fully into new projects too.
lines.style: Conclusive, gently warm, voicing confidence in the candidate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうだね。じゃあ説明会のシナリオは、経営陣の前で堂々と話せるよう、ふたりでしっかり準備しよう。
lines.en: Indeed. Then let's prepare the briefing script thoroughly together so we can present confidently in front of the executives.
lines.style: Encouraging team-leader tone, warm but firm closing remark.
